Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal upcoming — capacity + isolation questions

Hi Dylan,

Our renewal is coming up in March and we need to expand our private footprint. Two main asks:

- Add an isolated VPC in us-west for a new regulatory environment (PHI handling).
- Provision +20% steady-state capacity with ability to burst to +50% for scheduled processing windows (monthly).

Can you confirm lead times for an additional cluster, whether we need term changes for reserved capacity, and any network prerequisites from our side?

Attaching our tentative schedule and a short network checklist.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
Head of Platform Ops, Medisystems
jenna.park@medisystems.com
Attachments: renewal_sched_q1.pdf (plan), network_checklist.docx (doc)
From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@medisystems.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal upcoming — capacity + isolation questions

Hi Jenna — thanks for the details and the checklist. Short answers up front:

- Additional isolated VPC: yes, we can stand up a private environment in us-west with PHI-focused controls. Typical provisioning is 3–4 weeks from acceptance (hardware and network coordination).
- Capacity: we can reserve +20% steady capacity as part of the renewal. Burst policy to +50% can be configured as transient burst capacity (subject to a short warm-up for GPU pools).
- Terms: increasing reserved capacity will require an amendment to your renewal SOW and a short 12-month addendum (we can align term end to your existing renewal date).

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment with Redwood infra and pricing -> I'll loop in our renewal lead.
2) We prepare a draft SOW amendment and a capacity estimate for your finance review.
3) Schedule a technical kickoff with your network/security team to confirm connectivity (VPC peering, IP allowlists, KMS exchange).

I copied Marissa, Neha, and Rishi on this thread to scope cost and timelines. Can you confirm any blackout windows in Feb/Mar for us to avoid?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding Jenna's ask. High-level requirements: new private VPC in us-west, PHI controls, +20% reserved capacity with +50% burst. Renewal in March; customer prefers minimal term disruption but will accept a 12-month amendment to align reserved capacity.

Please reply with:
- Marissa: updated pricing for +20% reserved capacity and incremental burst pricing (monthly and one-time infra setup).
- Neha: operational SLOs, SLA exceptions for isolated environments, and what we can promise for PHI handling (KMS/HSM setup time).
- Rishi: provisioning lead time, any constraints on adding a cluster to their existing private footprint, and recommended instance types/quantization profiles for cost control.

Aim for a consolidated response by EOD Thursday so I can feed back to the customer.

Thanks,
Dylan

Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Renewal upcoming — capacity + isolation questions (Medisystems)

Dylan — draft pricing and commercial notes below:

- One-time setup fee (isolated VPC & onboarding): $28,000 (includes network validation, KMS integration, and deployment runbook).
- Reserved capacity (steady +20%): $14,500/month (annualized equivalent shown on renewal).
- Burst buffer (on-demand burst up to +50%): usage-based at standard on-demand rates; recommend capping monthly burst spend with a soft alert.
- Term recommendation: 12-month capacity amendment that attaches to the existing renewal date. We can offer a 6% uplift discount on the incremental reserved line if they sign amendment within 30 days.

Attachments: capacity_estimate_meditech.xlsx (breakdown), SOW_v2.pdf (amendment template).

Marissa
Sr. Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Renewal upcoming — capacity + isolation questions (Medisystems)

Quick tech notes for the SOW and schedule:

- Lead time: 3 weeks minimum for a single additional cluster if we can reuse existing region hardware; 4–6 weeks if new racks or air-gapped provisioning is required.
- Network: we need 2 static /29s for control and management subnets plus a peering config; customer must allow management IPs (listed in network_diagram_vpc.png).
- PHI controls: KMS integration to their HSM takes ~7 business days once we have service principal & certs. Audit log retention for this environment is standard 1y; we can extend to 3y with a retention add-on.
- Capacity sizing: recommend a mixed pool: 60% quantized instances for baseline and 40% higher-precision instances for peak jobs to keep cost efficient.

No blockers from infra; longest pole is any procurement lead time on their side for certs/peering.

Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — this is helpful.

We are aligned to proceed with the 12-month capacity amendment and will accept the one-time setup fee. Two asks before we sign:
1) Can you include an explicit 72-hour response SLA for incident severity P1s on the isolated environment in the SOW?
2) Please provide the updated SOW_v2.pdf and the capacity_estimate_meditech.xlsx with the 6% amendment discount visible so I can circulate to finance.

We'll target signing the amendment by Feb 10 if the SOW matches. Please also send the DocuSign link when ready.

Best,
Jenna
